stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"In the guide list, 'general track' is listed among the exposures (kinds of investment), which does not make sense: it is a mix, not one kind.","where":"the exposures group of the guide list","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: The page gives no costs, returns or risk level for any product
Nothing on the page is aimed at someone near retirement
Unclear what the menu item 'מקור' (source) means
Only half understood the line saying each product page lists what you can invest in
'קרן חדשה כללית' says 'above the maximum amount' without saying what that maximum is
Did not understand the 'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים' card at all
The 'מסלול כללי' (general track) card doesn't say how much of the money is in shares
The seven index cards look the same, and none says how much you could lose
Unclear what the grey 'יומית'/'מתחדשת' buttons under קרן כספית are for
The 'בשפה פשוטה' (in simple language) line is missing from most boxes
Unclear whether 'exposure to the dollar or neutralised from it' is good or bad
'קרן שעוקבת אחריו': who runs such a fund and where to buy it is unclear
מק"ם and אג"ח are used before they are explained
Unclear whether the managing company's investment committee looks out for the saver
No information on management fees anywhere
No current deposit interest rates
No actual yearly ceiling for קופת גמל להשקעה
The legal waiting period for קרן השתלמות is not stated
Nothing on whether money is protected if the managing company fails
The tax rate on profit when withdrawing from קופת גמל להשקעה is not stated
Nothing on pension payout options at retirement (monthly payment vs lump sum)
Would drop the 'לילדים' (children) section
Would drop the 'לבחירה עצמית' (self-managed) section

problems.why: The reader's complaint about the general track is that it doesn't say how much is in shares, not that it is wrong to list a mixed track among the kinds of investment.
